# Sidebar

> Responsive app sidebar with resizing, offcanvas and icon collapse, double sidebar layers, mobile navigation, and nested menus.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `sidebar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/sidebar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/sidebar.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.78.0`

## Composition

### Shared mobile navigation

Declare destinations and their behavior once in the application. Render the same items for the desktop sidebar and mobile primary destinations; Menu opens the existing sidebar content. The provider shares visibility, while the application owns route selection.

```tsx
<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar>
    mobileVariant="drawer"; complete navigation
      <SidebarContent>
        <SidebarMenu />
      </SidebarContent>
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    route content
  </SidebarInset>
  <SidebarMobileNav>
    <SidebarMobileNavItem />
    <SidebarMobileTrigger />
  </SidebarMobileNav>
</SidebarProvider>
```

### Application shell

SidebarMenuButton styles its first icon; iconTone colors that icon muted, success, warning, or danger for a status such as a run result.

```tsx
<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarHeader />
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupLabel />
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton />
              <SidebarMenuBadge />
              <SidebarMenuAction />
              <SidebarMenuSub>
                <SidebarMenuItem>
                  <SidebarMenuButton />
                </SidebarMenuItem>
              </SidebarMenuSub>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
    </SidebarContent>
    <SidebarFooter />
    <SidebarRail />
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    <SidebarTrigger />
  </SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>
```

### Collapsible navigation group

```tsx
<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarMenu>
          <SidebarMenuItem>
            <Collapsible>
              <SidebarMenuButton>
                render prop
                  <CollapsibleTrigger />
              </SidebarMenuButton>
              <CollapsibleContent>
                <SidebarMenuSub>
                  <SidebarMenuItem>
                    <SidebarMenuButton />
                  </SidebarMenuItem>
                </SidebarMenuSub>
              </CollapsibleContent>
            </Collapsible>
          </SidebarMenuItem>
        </SidebarMenu>
      </SidebarGroup>
    </SidebarContent>
  </Sidebar>
</SidebarProvider>
```

### Double sidebar

One Sidebar holds both panes, so they share one landmark, collapse state, and mobile sheet. The icon rail always shows icons with tooltips; collapsible="icon" keeps it and hides the panel. layer places each pane on the sidebar surface, its own raised card, or (for the panel) the content card.

```tsx
<SidebarProvider>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarIconRail>
      layer="raised"; sections
        <SidebarContent>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton />
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarContent>
    </SidebarIconRail>
    <SidebarPanel>
      layer="content"; pages of the selected section
        <SidebarHeader />
        <SidebarContent>
          <SidebarGroup />
        </SidebarContent>
    </SidebarPanel>
  </Sidebar>
  <SidebarInset>
    <SidebarTrigger />
  </SidebarInset>
</SidebarProvider>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { ChevronRightIcon, FolderIcon, HashIcon, LayersIcon, MoreHorizontalIcon, SettingsIcon, SparklesIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { SidebarLayout } from "@/components/control-ui/skin";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/avatar";
import { Card, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/card";
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/collapsible";
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label";
import { NativeSelect } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/native-select";
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarFooter,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarGroupContent,
  SidebarGroupLabel,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarInset,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuAction,
  SidebarMenuBadge,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarMenuSub,
  SidebarProvider,
  SidebarRail,
  type SidebarSelectionIndicator,
  SidebarTrigger,
  useSidebar,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/sidebar";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/table";
import { Heading, Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const workspaceItems = [
  { title: "Agents", icon: SparklesIcon, size: "default", disabled: false, unread: 3 },
  { title: "Workflows", icon: LayersIcon, size: "sm", disabled: false, unread: 12 },
  { title: "Tools", icon: HashIcon, size: "default", disabled: true, unread: 0 },
] as const;
const projectPages = ["Overview", "Design system", "API integration"];

function WorkspaceNavigation({
  active,
  onNavigate,
  indicator,
  nested,
}: {
  active: string;
  onNavigate: (page: string) => void;
  indicator?: SidebarSelectionIndicator;
  nested: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <SidebarGroupLabel>Workspace</SidebarGroupLabel>
        <SidebarGroupContent>
          <SidebarMenu indicator={indicator} aria-label="Workspace">
            {workspaceItems.map((item) => (
              <SidebarMenuItem key={item.title}>
                <SidebarMenuButton
                  isActive={active === item.title}
                  size={item.size}
                  onClick={() => onNavigate(item.title)}
                  disabled={item.disabled}
                  tooltip={item.title}
                >
                  <item.icon />
                  <span>{item.title}</span>
                </SidebarMenuButton>
                {item.unread ? (
                  <SidebarMenuBadge>
                    {item.unread}
                    <span className="sr-only"> unread</span>
                  </SidebarMenuBadge>
                ) : null}
                <DropdownMenu>
                  <DropdownMenuTrigger
                    render={<SidebarMenuAction showOnHover />}
                    disabled={item.disabled}
                    aria-label={`${item.title} actions`}
                  >
                    <MoreHorizontalIcon />
                  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                  <DropdownMenuContent side="right" align="start">
                    <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onNavigate(`${item.title} settings`)}>Settings for {item.title}</DropdownMenuItem>
                  </DropdownMenuContent>
                </DropdownMenu>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
            ))}
            {nested ? (
              <SidebarMenuItem>
                <Collapsible defaultOpen>
                  <SidebarMenuButton render={<CollapsibleTrigger />} tooltip="Projects">
                    <FolderIcon />
                    <span>Projects</span>
                    <ChevronRightIcon data-control-ui="sidebar" data-slot="chevron" />
                  </SidebarMenuButton>
                  <CollapsibleContent>
                    <SidebarMenuSub indicator={indicator} aria-label="Projects">
                      {projectPages.map((title) => (
                        <SidebarMenuItem key={title}>
                          <SidebarMenuButton size="sm" isActive={active === title} onClick={() => onNavigate(title)}>
                            <span>{title}</span>
                          </SidebarMenuButton>
                        </SidebarMenuItem>
                      ))}
                    </SidebarMenuSub>
                  </CollapsibleContent>
                </Collapsible>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
            ) : null}
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" isActive={active === "Settings"} onClick={() => onNavigate("Settings")} tooltip="Settings">
                <SettingsIcon />
                <span className="flex-1">Settings</span>
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarGroupContent>
      </SidebarGroup>
      <SidebarGroup>
        <Collapsible defaultOpen>
          <SidebarGroupLabel render={<CollapsibleTrigger />}>
            <span>Resources</span>
            <ChevronRightIcon data-control-ui="sidebar" data-slot="chevron" />
          </SidebarGroupLabel>
          <CollapsibleContent>
            <SidebarMenu indicator={indicator} aria-label="Resources">
              <SidebarMenuItem>
                <SidebarMenuButton render={<a href="/get-started" />} tooltip="Documentation">
                  <LayersIcon />
                  <span>Documentation</span>
                </SidebarMenuButton>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
            </SidebarMenu>
          </CollapsibleContent>
        </Collapsible>
      </SidebarGroup>
    </SidebarContent>
  );
}

function Workspace({
  variant,
  indicator,
  nested,
  resizable,
  side,
  collapsible,
}: {
  variant: SidebarLayout;
  resizable: boolean;
  side: "left" | "right";
  indicator?: SidebarSelectionIndicator;
  nested: boolean;
  collapsible: "icon" | "offcanvas" | "none";
}) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(nested ? "Design system" : "Agents");
  const { setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();

  function navigate(page: string) {
    setActive(page);
    setOpenMobile(false);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Sidebar variant={variant} side={side} collapsible={resizable ? "offcanvas" : collapsible} className="h-full">
        <SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Acme workspace" onClick={() => navigate("Overview")}>
            <Avatar aria-hidden="true" size="sm">
              <AvatarFallback>A</AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
            <span>Acme workspace</span>
          </SidebarMenuButton>
        </SidebarHeader>
        <WorkspaceNavigation active={active} onNavigate={navigate} indicator={indicator} nested={nested} />
        <SidebarFooter>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Jamie Davis" />}>
              <Avatar aria-hidden="true" size="sm">
                <AvatarFallback>JD</AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <span>Jamie Davis</span>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent side="inline-end" align="end">
              <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => navigate("Profile")}>Profile</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => navigate("Settings")}>Settings</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </SidebarFooter>
        {resizable ? <SidebarRail /> : null}
      </Sidebar>
      <SidebarInset>
        <header className="flex h-14 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b border-border px-3">
          {resizable || collapsible !== "none" ? <SidebarTrigger /> : null}
          <Text size="label" weight="medium" className="truncate">
            {active}
          </Text>
        </header>
        <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4 overflow-auto p-5">
          <div>
            <Text as="p" size="caption" tone="muted">
              Acme workspace
            </Text>
            <Heading level={3} className="mt-1">
              {active}
            </Heading>
          </div>
          <Card size="sm">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Your workspace, at a glance</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>Browse your team’s agents, workflows, and projects from the sidebar.</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
          </Card>
          <Table aria-label="Projects">
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Project</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-end">Last updated</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Customer support</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-end">Today</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell>Research assistant</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-end">Yesterday</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      </SidebarInset>
    </>
  );
}

function SidebarExample({
  variant = "sidebar",
  label,
  nested = false,
  controls = false,
  resizable = false,
  side = "left",
}: {
  variant?: SidebarLayout;
  label: string;
  nested?: boolean;
  controls?: boolean;
  resizable?: boolean;
  side?: "left" | "right";
}) {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(280);
  const [indicator, setIndicator] = useState<SidebarSelectionIndicator>();
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<SidebarLayout>();
  const [sidebarSide, setSidebarSide] = useState(side);
  const [collapsible, setCollapsible] = useState<"icon" | "offcanvas" | "none">("icon");
  const layoutId = useId();
  const highlightId = useId();
  const sideId = useId();
  const collapseId = useId();

  return (
    <fieldset aria-label={label} className="w-full min-w-0">
      {controls ? (
        <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <Label htmlFor={layoutId} className="shrink-0">
            Layout
          </Label>
          <NativeSelect
            id={layoutId}
            className="w-32"
            value={layout ?? variant}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.target.value;
              if (value === "sidebar" || value === "floating" || value === "inset" || value === "page") setLayout(value);
            }}
          >
            <option value="sidebar">Sidebar</option>
            <option value="floating">Floating</option>
            <option value="inset">Inset</option>
            <option value="page">Page</option>
          </NativeSelect>
          <Label htmlFor={highlightId} className="shrink-0">
            Menu highlight
          </Label>
          <NativeSelect
            id={highlightId}
            className="w-40"
            value={indicator ?? "skin"}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.target.value;
              if (value === "none" || value === "slide" || value === "hover") setIndicator(value);
              else setIndicator(undefined);
            }}
          >
            <option value="skin">Skin default</option>
            <option value="none">Static</option>
            <option value="slide">Sliding selection</option>
            <option value="hover">Fluid hover</option>
          </NativeSelect>
          <Label htmlFor={sideId}>Side</Label>
          <NativeSelect
            id={sideId}
            className="w-24"
            value={sidebarSide}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.target.value;
              if (value === "left" || value === "right") setSidebarSide(value);
            }}
          >
            <option value="left">Left</option>
            <option value="right">Right</option>
          </NativeSelect>
          <Label htmlFor={collapseId}>Collapse</Label>
          <NativeSelect
            id={collapseId}
            className="w-32"
            value={collapsible}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const value = event.target.value;
              if (value === "icon" || value === "offcanvas" || value === "none") setCollapsible(value);
            }}
          >
            <option value="icon">Icon rail</option>
            <option value="offcanvas">Off-canvas</option>
            <option value="none">Fixed</option>
          </NativeSelect>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="relative isolate h-[30rem] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-(--radius-panel) border border-border bg-canvas [transform:translateZ(0)]">
        <SidebarProvider
          persistOpen={false}
          keyboardShortcut={null}
          width={resizable && side === "right" ? width : undefined}
          onWidthChange={resizable && side === "right" ? setWidth : undefined}
          layout="contained"
          defaultWidth={224}
        >
          <Workspace
            variant={layout ?? variant}
            indicator={indicator}
            nested={nested}
            resizable={resizable}
            side={sidebarSide}
            collapsible={collapsible}
          />
        </SidebarProvider>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarExample() {
  return <SidebarExample label="Sidebar" controls />;
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarNestedExample() {
  return <SidebarExample label="Nested navigation" nested />;
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarFloatingExample() {
  return <SidebarExample variant="floating" label="Floating" />;
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarInsetExample() {
  return <SidebarExample variant="inset" label="Inset" />;
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarResizableExample() {
  return <SidebarExample label="Resizable" resizable />;
}

export function PrimitiveSidebarRightExample() {
  return <SidebarExample label="Right sidebar" resizable side="right" />;
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `sidebar`
  - `container`
  - `content`
  - `content-stack`
  - `footer`
  - `gap`
  - `group`
  - `group-content`
  - `group-label`
  - `header`: `data-divider`
  - `icon-rail`: `data-collapsible` (`icon`), `data-layer` (`raised` | `sidebar`)
  - `inner`
  - `inset`
  - `menu`: `data-indicator` (any value)
  - `menu-action`: `data-show-on-hover`
  - `menu-badge`
  - `menu-button`: `data-active`, `data-icon-tone` (`danger` | `default` | `muted` | `success` | `warning`), `data-indicator` (any value), `data-size` (`default` | `lg` | `sm`), `data-track-item`, `data-variant` (`default` | `outline`)
  - `menu-item`
  - `menu-track`: `data-indicator` (any value), `data-track` (any value)
  - `mobile-nav`: `data-variant` (`bar` | `floating`)
  - `mobile-nav-container`: `data-layout` (`contained` | `viewport`), `data-variant` (`bar` | `floating`)
  - `mobile-trigger`: `data-mobile-nav-item`, `data-sidebar-trigger`
  - `panel`: `data-layer` (`content` | `raised` | `sidebar`)
  - `rail`: `data-resizable`, `data-resize-ready`
  - `resize-shield`
  - `root`: `data-collapsible` (`icon` | `none` | `offcanvas`), `data-mobile`, `data-side` (`left` | `right`), `data-state` (`collapsed` | `expanded`), `data-variant` (`floating` | `inset` | `page` | `sidebar`)
  - `skip-link`
  - `trigger`: `data-sidebar-trigger`
  - `wrapper`: `data-layout` (`contained` | `viewport`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### sidebar

- `--cui-sidebar-nav-height`: `4.5rem`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-background`: `var(--sidebar)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-foreground`: `var(--sidebar-foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-shadow`: `var(--shadow-md)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-item-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-item-active-background`: `var(--active-fill)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-item-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-nav-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-sidebar-icon-rail-border-width`: `1px`
- `--cui-sidebar-icon-rail-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-sidebar-raised-background`: `var(--cui-sidebar-inset-background)`
- `--cui-sidebar-raised-border-width`: `var(--cui-sidebar-inset-border-width)`
- `--cui-sidebar-raised-border-color`: `var(--cui-sidebar-inset-border-color)`
- `--cui-sidebar-raised-radius`: `var(--cui-sidebar-inset-radius)`
- `--cui-sidebar-raised-shadow`: `var(--cui-sidebar-inset-shadow)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-floating-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-floating-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-floating-shadow`: `var(--shadow-md)`
- `--cui-sidebar-skip-link-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-sidebar-skip-link-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-skip-link-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-sidebar-skip-link-shadow`: `var(--shadow-md)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-badge-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-badge-background`: `oklch(from var(--sidebar-foreground) l c h / 0.08)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-badge-foreground`: `var(--sidebar-foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-header-border-width`: `1px`
- `--cui-sidebar-header-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-sidebar-rail-divider-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-badge-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-icon-foreground`: `currentColor`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-active-icon-foreground`: `currentColor`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-wrapper-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-wrapper-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-background`: `var(--sidebar)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-backdrop-filter`: `none`
- `--cui-sidebar-container-border-width`: `1px`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-border-width`: `0px`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-radius`: `0px`
- `--cui-sidebar-inner-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-header-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-header-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-border-width`: `0px`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-radius`: `var(--radius-xl)`
- `--cui-sidebar-inset-inset`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-radius`: `var(--radius-popup-item)`
- `--cui-sidebar-group-label-foreground`: `oklch(from var(--sidebar-foreground) l c h / 0.7)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-foreground`: `var(--sidebar-foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-hover-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-active-background`: `var(--active-fill)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-active-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-track-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-height`: `var(--control-h-md)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-padding-block`: `0px`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon) / 2 - var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-normal)`
- `--cui-sidebar-menu-button-active-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
- `--cui-sidebar-group-label-font-size`: `var(--text-caption)`
- `--cui-sidebar-group-label-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`

- `--cui-sidebar-group-label-text-transform`: `none`
